messages:
alex: Quick q — PR 4872 is docs + a toggle that defaults OFF. Do we bump patch for this?
maria: If it's docs-only I'd say no bump, but toggles historically trigger a patch if they change behavior in prod. This one defaults off tho.
chris: what's the toggle scope? global or per-account?
sasha: global; it's behind a feature flag and the default is off, but ops might enable it for a specific customer during onboarding.
alex: Right. The code change is just a conditional check plus a tiny telemetry ping. No DB migrations.
chris: telemetry ping can be considered behavior change. I'd still treat this as patch unless we flip on by default.
maria: Agreed. Patch seems fine. We should also add a short release note: "internal: opt-in feature flag for X (off by default)" and mark as docs-only?
sasha: Do we have tagging guidance for backports? If a customer requests a backport to stable, do we cherry-pick and tag as patch or create a hotfix branch?
alex: Our playbook says backports of non-breaking fixes -> patch. For anything that might change behavior even behind a flag, prefer a hotfix branch and an explicit patch tag.
chris: Also, should CI add a label so the release bot knows to include/exclude? e.g., `release: patch` vs `release: no`
releasebot: deploy queue updated: queued PR 4872 for branch main. Please add a `release:` label to control versioning.
maria: I'll add `release: patch` and a `release-note: internal opt-in flag (off)` label.
karen: Quick ops note — when rolling out flags we usually do a canary for 24h then 100% over 3 days. If ops plan to enable for one customer only, we can avoid broad rollout.
sasha: Rollback criteria: if error rate spikes > 0.5% above baseline for 15m or latency p95 increases > 200ms, rollback. Documented in the rollout checklist.
achris: Minor nit: tagging convention — do we use `vX.Y.Z` annotated tag or lightweight tag for patches? Ops prefers annotated tags for audit.
maria: Annotated tags for releases please. We also append `+hotfix.<id>` when it's a customer hotfix.
alex: Consensus then: patch bump, annotated tag, canary per ops checklist. I'll add the labels and update PR description with rollback criteria.
chris: SGTM. Also add a small note in CHANGELOG under Unreleased > Internal.
releasebot: started build for main @ 1999012355
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for service-inf-1 on zone-a at 1999012360
deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded (metrics within thresholds) at 1999012390 :tada:
alex: thanks all — merging after green CI and the labels are set.
